On M21, the permission model is prefix-only (as the committed test documents), so a spelling like `git push -u origin claude/x:main` or `git push -u origin claude/x --force` is not deny-matched; it is no longer auto-allowed either only because the allow prefix `git push -u origin claude/` does match it — that shape remains auto-allowed and relies on the GitHub `Protections` ruleset and guard-push.mjs. Claude Code's live matcher (Bash prefix semantics and MCP rule case-sensitivity) was not executed; the fixes follow the model the repository's own tests rely on.
